new_jobs.description:
GT  was founded in 2019 by a former Apple, Nest, and Google executive.  GT’s mission is to connect the world’s best talent with product careers offered by high-growth companies in the UK, USA, Canada, Germany, and the Netherlands. 
 On behalf of  Feeld , GT is looking for a  Staff Infrastructure Engineer (AWS)  to help shape and scale the infrastructure behind a fast-growing consumer mobile product in the online dating space. 
  About the Client   
 Founded in 2014 as a dating app,  Feeld  gathered millions of users in one place to create a safer and more inclusive space online for everyone open to experiencing people and relationships in a new way. Their mission is to elevate the human experience of sexuality and relationships and create a world where everyone is more intimately connected to each other and themselves.  

  About the Project  
 You'll join a consumer mobile product with an engineering and product organization of around 50 people distributed across Europe, the US, and LATAM. 
 The engineering organization works in small, autonomous product squads supported by a dedicated Infrastructure Team responsible for building and maintaining the secure, scalable, and reliable cloud infrastructure that powers Feeld. 
 The team is focused on evolving its AWS infrastructure through Infrastructure as Code, automation, and resilient architecture. A key priority is reducing manual operational work, improving infrastructure consistency, and enabling product squads to build and deploy with greater speed and confidence. As Feeld supports  millions of members  and handles sensitive personal data, infrastructure security, privacy, and operational resilience are central to the team's work. 
 
 
  Technology stack:  AWS (ECS/Fargate, Lambda, RDS/Aurora PostgreSQL, DynamoDB), Terraform, Cloudflare, CI/CD, and AWS networking services. 
 
 
  Team:  You'll join the Infrastructure Team, working closely with engineering teams across Europe, the US, and LATAM. 
 
 
  About the Role  
 We are looking for an experienced  Staff Infrastructure Engineer  with deep hands-on expertise in AWS and Terraform to help shape the technical direction of Feeld's cloud infrastructure. 
 This is a  hands-on Staff-level individual contributor role , combining infrastructure engineering and operational responsibilities with technical leadership and architectural decision-making. 
 You will work alongside the Infrastructure Team to design and maintain secure, resilient, and scalable infrastructure, improve Terraform architecture, automate operational processes, and ensure production systems remain reliable as the product grows. 
 Beyond day-to-day engineering, you'll help establish infrastructure standards, influence technical decisions across teams, and build solutions that make other engineers more effective. The ideal candidate has already demonstrated this level of technical ownership and impact in previous roles. 

  Responsibilities  
 
 
 Share the Infrastructure team's day-to-day work from your first weeks (requests, upgrades, daily checks and incidents), and join on-call once it's in place. 
 
 
 Shape the technical direction and standards for our AWS infrastructure with the Infrastructure team, and own the roadmap together. 
 
 
 Design and build Terraform modules and patterns that make the secure, reliable way the easy way for product squads. 
 
 
 Keep FEELD infrastructure fully in code as it grows, including our edge on Cloudflare and AWS, close the remaining gaps, and automate drift detection so the code stays the source of truth. 
 
 
 Evolve how FEELD Terraform is organised and applied (state, environments, module boundaries) as the estate grows, so changes stay small, reviewable and safe to roll out. 
 
 
 Automate operational work, such as database migrations, routine production tasks and daily checks, into pipelines with review and audit trails.
